**Why are you interested in validating on gno.land?**

We are interested in gno.land because of its unique Proof of Contribution model and focus on transparent, auditable, and forkable smart contracts written in Gno (a deterministic Go variant).  

We also see strong potential in future IBC interoperability with our existing validator operations. Participating in the early testnet phase allows us to contribute meaningfully while the network is still developing.

**What contributions have you made or are willing to make to gno.land?**


Run a reliable validator node during all testnet phases and actively report issues/bugs.  
Share operational best practices and monitoring configurations.  
Contribute to validator tooling and infrastructure documentation.  
Provide testing, feedback, and improvements as the network progresses toward mainnet.  
Long-term: Develop or improve open-source tools that benefit the gno.land validator community.
